    async def open_observer(case: str, artifact_dir: Path) -> AsyncIterator[Observer]:
        from toad.app import ToadApp
    
        root = Path(artifact_dir).resolve()
        root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (root / "project").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        env = {"XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(root / "config"), "XDG_DATA_HOME": str(root / "data"),
               "XDG_STATE_HOME": str(root / "state"), "AGENT_COMMS_ROOT": str(root / "wire")}
        previous = {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in env}
        os.environ.update(env)
        try:
            app = ToadApp(project_dir=str(root / "project"))
            async with app.run_test(size=(120, 40)) as pilot:
                # Toad starts with no tab open; the observed session is opened here.
                await app.session_navigation.new(app.session_navigation.default_source)
                session = app.selected_session
                assert isinstance(session, MainScreen)
                await session.wait_content_ready()
                await pilot.pause()
                view = session.conversation
                agent = Agent(root / "project", AgentDefinition.decode(AGENT_DATA), SESSION_ID)
                observer = Observer(case, app, pilot, agent, session, root)
                try:
                    view.agent = agent
                    await exercise_boundaries(agent, view, pilot)
                    yield observer
                    assert len(observer.receipts) == 1
                    assert observer.permissions == (0 if case == "no_controller" else 1)
                    assert observer.disconnected_seen == (case == "disconnect")
                    assert not notes(observer.view)
                    assert app._exception is None
                    (root / "toad-evidence.json").write_text(json.dumps({
                        "case": case, "session": observer.agent.session_id,
                        "renderedReceipts": observer.receipts,
            assert comms.registry.require("beta").process_identity == restarted
    
    
    async def test_a_second_thread_opened_from_the_app_answers_its_first_message(workspace, native_package):
        from support.native import MODEL
    
        async def declare_second(comms, project, _provider):
            comms.registry.declare(comms.registry.new_thread("gamma", frozenset({"team"}), str(project), model=MODEL, thinking_level=OffThinkingLevel))
    
        async with native_session(workspace, prepare=declare_second) as native:
            ui, provider = native.ui, native.provider
            app, _pilot = ui.textual
            owner_tab = ui.selected_tab
            await ui.until_agent_ready()
            opened = await app.thread_navigation.open(owner_mode=owner_tab, project_path=native.project, target="gamma")
            assert opened != owner_tab and ui.selected_tab == opened
            assert [tab.identity for tab in ui.tabs()] == [owner_tab, opened]
            view = ui.conversation
            await ui.until(lambda: view.agent is not None and view.agent is not native.agent, seconds=20,
                           why="the second thread's agent")
            await ui.until_agent_ready()
            await ui.write_draft("FIRST_MESSAGE_TO_GAMMA")
            await ui.press("enter")
            await ui.until(lambda: "NATIVE_RESPONSE_1" in ui.painted(view.window), seconds=40, why="the first answer")
            await ui.until(lambda: not native.comms.registry.require("gamma").executing, seconds=20, why="the turn to finish")
            assert len(provider.requests) == 1
            assert ui.painted(view.window).count("NATIVE_RESPONSE_1") == 1
            assert [tab.identity for tab in ui.tabs()] == [owner_tab, opened]
            await view.agent.stop()
    
    
    
    class OperationalSessionSources:
        """Own existing operational resources while the view is detached."""
    
        def __init__(self) -> None:
            self.agent_binding = NoAgentBound()
            self.shell = None
            self.load_plan = EnsuringSessionLoadPlan()
    
        def status_row(self, conversation: Conversation):
            row = self.activity_row(conversation).with_delivery(conversation.input_delivery)
            return conversation.agent_binding.session_disposition.present(row, row.disconnected)
    
        def activity_row(self, conversation: Conversation):
            # A Core history source owns status even when its ACP load fails.
            if conversation.transcript.readable:
                return conversation.thread_activity.row
            return conversation.turns.binding.status_row(conversation.thread_activity.row)
    
        def agent_info(self, conversation: Conversation) -> str:
            return "shell"
    
        def make_conversation(self, screen: "MainScreen") -> Conversation:
            return Conversation(
                screen.project_path, screen._agent, screen._agent_session_id,
                screen._session_pk, screen.app.session_tracker.sessions[screen.id].initial_title,
                initial_prompt=screen._initial_prompt,
                transcript=screen.presentation.transcript,
            )
    
        def external_transcript_changed(self, conversation: Conversation) -> None:
            """Core publishes native and CLI drafts through the same transcript store."""
            from toad.transcript_publication import CanonicalSourcePublication
    
            conversation.transcript.source_requests.request(CanonicalSourcePublication)
    
        def prompt(self, conversation: Conversation):
            from toad.widgets.prompt import Prompt
    
            return Prompt(turns=conversation.turns, submissions=conversation.submissions)
    
        async def submit(self, owner, event):
            from toad.conversation_submission import InputSubmission
    
            return await InputSubmission.from_event(event, owner.view).execute(owner)
    
        def input_ready(self, conversation: Conversation) -> bool:
            agent = conversation.agent_binding
            if not agent.ready:
                return False
            if agent.configuration.model.requires_selection:
                return False
            if conversation.transcript.readable:
                presentation = conversation.thread_presentation
                return (presentation is not None
                        and ExistingOwnerPlan.from_binding(presentation.binding) is not None)
            return True
    
        def unavailable_reason(self, conversation: Conversation) -> str:
            presentation = conversation.thread_presentation
            agent = conversation.agent_binding
            if (conversation.transcript.readable and presentation is not None
                    and ExistingOwnerPlan.from_binding(presentation.binding) is None):
                line = self.activity_row(conversation).presentation.summary
            elif agent.configuration.model.requires_selection:
                line = "Choose a model or connect a provider (click here). Your draft is kept."
            else:
                line = self.activity_row(conversation).presentation.summary
            return self.activity_row(conversation).status.with_disconnection(
                line, lambda: agent.session_disposition.present(line, lambda status: status.notice))
    
        def start_agent(self, conversation: Conversation) -> None:
            conversation.agent_binding.start_agent(self, conversation)
    
        def create_agent(self, conversation: Conversation) -> None:
            """The unbound state requests a new operational connection."""
            from toad.acp.agent import Agent
            from toad.core import events as core_events
    
            assert conversation._agent_data is not None
            agent = Agent(conversation.project_path, conversation._agent_data,
                          conversation._agent_session_id, conversation._session_pk,
                          app_events=conversation.app.events,
                          transcripts=conversation.app.coordination_access.transcripts)

    class ParsedModule(SourceFileIdentity):
        """Parsed Python module together with its source text and path."""
    
        path: Path
        module_name: str
        is_package_init: bool
        module: ast.Module
        source: str
        semantic_hash: str | None = None
        family_cache_dir: Path | None = None
    
        @cached_property
        def native_compilation(self) -> NativePythonCompilation:
            """Share lazy compiler evidence over this module's original source context."""
            return NativePythonCompilation(self.source, self.file_path)
    
        @cached_property
        def collected_family_cache(self) -> "CollectedFamilyCacheContext":
            return CollectedFamilyCacheContext.from_source(
                path=self.path,
                module_name=self.module_name,
                source=self.source,
                family_cache_dir=self.family_cache_dir,
            )

        root: Path,
        *,
        cache_dir: Path | None = None,
        use_parse_cache: bool = True,
        parse_workers: int = _DEFAULT_PARSE_WORKERS,
        source_policy: PythonSourcePathPolicy | None = None,
    ) -> list[ParsedModule]:

            use_parse_cache=use_parse_cache,
            parse_workers=parse_workers,

        @cached_property
        def node_membership(self) -> frozenset[ast.AST]:
            """Actual nodes of this tree, shared by source-ownership checks."""
            return frozenset(self.depth_first_nodes)
    
        def indexed_nodes_of_type(
            self,
            node_type: type[SyntaxNodeT],
        ) -> tuple[tuple[int, SyntaxNodeT], ...]:
            """Project indexed exact-type nodes from the single syntax traversal."""
    
            return tuple(
                (index, cast(SyntaxNodeT, self.depth_first_nodes[index]))
                for index in self.node_indices_by_type.get(node_type, ())
            )
    
        def parent_node(self, node_index: int) -> ast.AST | None:
            """Return the indexed node's immediate parent, when one exists."""
    
            parent_index = self.parent_indices[node_index]
            if parent_index < 0:
                return None
            return self.depth_first_nodes[parent_index]

        def watch_agent_binding(self, binding: AgentBinding) -> None:
            # A presentation remount is not a fresh attachment. Start at the
            # Agent's current projection/floor so previously queued updates cannot
            # revive proof after its reducer entered quarantine or evidence loss.
            attachments = binding.presentation.attachments
            self.native_history_status = attachments.cursor
            self._private_cursor_sequence = attachments.cursor_sequence
            self.submissions.reset()
            # The observed presentation is Core's answer for this thread, not the
            # agent's; it stays until the next observation replaces it.
            self.arm_thread_read()
            if self.is_attached:
                self.refresh_thread_status()
            self.turns.bound()
            self.busy_count = 0
            binding.update_view(self)
    
    
        def create_agent(self, conversation: Conversation) -> None:
            """The unbound state requests a new operational connection."""
            from toad.acp.agent import Agent
            from toad.core import events as core_events
    
            assert conversation._agent_data is not None
            agent = Agent(conversation.project_path, conversation._agent_data,
                          conversation._agent_session_id, conversation._session_pk,
                          app_events=conversation.app.events,
                          transcripts=conversation.app.coordination_access.transcripts)
            agent.session.load_plan = self.load_plan
            conversation._native_agent_started_here = True
            conversation.bind_agent(agent)
            agent.controller.start_operation(agent.start(conversation.app.session_navigation.processes))
            conversation.publish_core(core_events.SessionSubtitleChanged(conversation.agent_title))
    
        def attach_started(self, screen: "MainScreen", plan) -> None:
            """An explicit Start action may attach the same retained view to its new owner."""
            self.load_plan = plan
            screen._agent = screen._agent or screen.app.agent_data
            conversation = screen.presentation.widget
            if conversation is not None:
                conversation._agent_data = screen._agent
                if screen.is_current:
                    conversation.start_native_session()
    
        async def present(self, conversation: Conversation) -> None:
            shell, self.shell = self.shell, None
            if shell is not None:
                conversation._shell = shell
                await shell.attach(AttachedSurfaceBinding(conversation, shell.events))
            conversation.bind_agent(self.agent_binding)
    
        async def detach(self, conversation: Conversation, screen: "MainScreen") -> None:
            self.agent_binding = conversation.agent_binding
            self.shell = conversation._shell
            conversation._shell = None
            if self.shell is not None:
                await self.shell.detach()
            self.agent_binding.detach_surface(conversation)
    
        async def close(self) -> None:
            agent, self.agent_binding = self.agent_binding, NoAgentBound()
            shell, self.shell = self.shell, None
            async with AsyncResourceRelease() as release:
                if shell is not None:
                    release.push_async_callback(shell.close)
                release.push_async_callback(agent.stop)
    
    
    """Textual-facing: a SessionObservation reads for a mounted view, and Textual's mount and removal bound its lifetime."""
    
    import asyncio
    
    import pytest
    from textual.app import App
    from textual.widget import Widget
    
    from toad.session_observation import InputDeliveryObservation, SessionObservation
    
    
    class ProbeObservation(SessionObservation):
        def __init__(self, view):
            super().__init__(view)
            self.responses = asyncio.Queue()
            self.entered = asyncio.Queue()
    
        async def read(self, agent):
            self.entered.put_nowait(agent)
            return await self.responses.get()
    
        def publish(self, view, result):
            view.result = result
    
        def failed(self, view, error):
            view.error = error
    
    
    class ProbeView(Widget):
        result = None
        error = None
        agent = object()
    
    
    async def next_read(observation):
        async with asyncio.timeout(10):
            return await observation.entered.get()
    
    
    async def test_invalidation_during_a_read_supersedes_its_result():
        view, app = ProbeView(), App()
        observation = ProbeObservation(view)
        async with app.run_test():
            await app.screen.mount(view)
            observation.invalidate()
            assert await next_read(observation) is view.agent
            observation.invalidate()
            observation.responses.put_nowait("superseded")
            assert await next_read(observation) is view.agent
            assert view.result is None
            observation.responses.put_nowait("current")
            await observation.task
            assert view.result == "current"
            assert app._exception is None
    
    
    async def test_a_read_for_a_previous_agent_is_not_published():
        view, app = ProbeView(), App()
        observation = ProbeObservation(view)
        async with app.run_test():
            await app.screen.mount(view)
            observation.invalidate()
            assert await next_read(observation) is view.agent
            observation.responses.put_nowait("current")
            await observation.task
            observation.invalidate()
            previous = await next_read(observation)
            view.agent = object()
            observation.responses.put_nowait("previous owner")
            assert await next_read(observation) is view.agent and view.agent is not previous
            assert view.result == "current"
            assert app._exception is None
    
    
    async def test_a_closed_observation_starts_no_read_and_delivery_actions_refuse():
        view, app = ProbeView(), App()
        observation = ProbeObservation(view)
        async with app.run_test() as pilot:
            await app.screen.mount(view)
            await observation.close()
            observation.invalidate()
            assert observation.task is None and observation.view is None
            delivery = InputDeliveryObservation(view)
            await delivery.close()
            for action in (delivery.history, delivery.dismiss_history):
                with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="connected owner changed"):
                    await action()
            await view.remove()
            await pilot.pause()
            assert app._exception is None

    """The install launch path, run the way an owner runs it, before any merge lands.
    
    0765a002c broke every ``agent-comms install`` without ``--repos``, and install 21
    refused because the target's owner probe asked the outgoing runtime for a method it no
    longer had (fixed in #2419); every required check passed both, because nothing ran the
    installer. This rehearses a real bus through the CLI under test, with the merge base's
    build installed as the outgoing runtime: launch, target tree, staged stack build,
    carried practice copy and the outgoing runtime's owner probe.
    """
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import os
    import sqlite3
    import subprocess
    import sys
    from contextlib import closing
    from pathlib import Path
    
    import pytest
    
    from agent_comms.field_codec import FieldCodec
    from agent_comms.installer.backup import bus_files
    from agent_comms.installer.commands import InstallCommands
    from agent_comms.installer.practice import TestHome
    from agent_comms.installer.upgrade import (
        CarriedRehearsal,
        RehearsedUpgrade,
        Stack,
        UncopiedRehearsal,
        Upgrade,
    )
    from agent_comms.maintenance_barrier import MaintenanceBarrier
    from agent_comms.registry_store import RegistryStore
    from agent_comms.repo import Checkout, ScratchCheckout
    from agent_comms.typed_table import ReconciledFile
    from conftest import declare_test_bus, publish_initial
    
    REPOSITORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    
    
    def git(*arguments: str) -> str:
        return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", REPOSITORY, *arguments], check=True,
                              capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    
    
    @pytest.fixture(scope="module")
    def installed_home(tmp_path_factory) -> dict[str, str]:
        """A home holding what an installed machine has: the installer's uv, and as the
        installed runtime a build of the merge base this change lands on. Both cases share
        it, so the second reuses the staged runtime the first built, as a second install
        would. Package caches stay shared."""
        home = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("installed-home")
        uv = home / ".local/state/agent-comms/upgrade-bus/uv"
        uv.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        uv.symlink_to(TestHome(home).uv)
        caches = subprocess.run([uv, "cache", "dir"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
        environment = {**os.environ, "HOME": str(home), "UV_CACHE_DIR": caches.stdout.strip(),
                       "npm_config_cache": str(Path.home() / ".npm")}
        environment.pop("PYTHONPATH", None)
        # The checkout owner adds the tree with its pinned submodules; `git archive` drops them.
        base = ScratchCheckout.add(REPOSITORY, home / "outgoing-source",
                                   git("merge-base", "HEAD", "origin/main"), "--detach")
        try:
            outgoing = Stack.build(base.path, InstallCommands(), home)
        finally:
            base.retire()
        (home / ".local/share/agent-comms/current").symlink_to(
            outgoing.runtime.prefix, target_is_directory=True)
        return environment
    
    
    @pytest.fixture
    def install_checkout(tmp_path) -> Path:
        checkout = tmp_path / "checkout"
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--shared", "-q", REPOSITORY, checkout], check=True)
        Checkout(checkout).prepare()
        return checkout
    
    
    def drop_one_index(root: Path) -> None:
        """One declared store's schema drifts from both runtimes' declarations."""
        for path in sorted(ReconciledFile.existing_in(root)):
            with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as db:
                index = db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index'"
                                   " AND sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name LIMIT 1").fetchone()
                if index:
                    db.execute(f'DROP INDEX "{index[0]}"')
                    db.commit()
                    return
        raise AssertionError("No declared store has an index to drop")
    
    
    @pytest.mark.timeout(280)
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("repos, rehearsal", (
        ((), UncopiedRehearsal), (("--repos",), CarriedRehearsal),
    ), ids=("kept-repos-nothing-to-carry", "given-repos-drifted-store"))
    def test_install_rehearses_without_changing_the_bus(private_comms, installed_home, install_checkout, tmp_path,
                                                        repos, rehearsal):
        """A bus with nothing to carry is rehearsed without a copy; one store whose schema
        drifted makes the rehearsal copy the bus and carry it. Neither changes the bus."""
        comms = private_comms
        declare_test_bus(comms, channels=("comms",), threads=(
            comms.registry.new_thread(name="worker", tags=frozenset(), worktree=str(tmp_path)),))
        publish_initial(comms, "worker", "#all", "One message before the install")
        if rehearsal is CarriedRehearsal:
            drop_one_index(comms.root)
        checkout = install_checkout
        before = bus_files(comms.root)
        given = (*repos, str(checkout)) if repos else ()
        installed = subprocess.run(
            [Path(sys.executable).with_name("agent-comms"), "--root", comms.root, "install",
             "--rehearse", "--checkout", checkout, "--to", "HEAD", "--project", checkout, *given],
            cwd=checkout, env={**installed_home, "PYTHONPATH": os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", "")},
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=270)
        assert installed.returncode == 0, installed.stderr
        result = FieldCodec.decode(Upgrade, FieldCodec.parse(installed.stdout))
        assert isinstance(result, RehearsedUpgrade) and type(result.rehearsal) is rehearsal
        assert bus_files(comms.root) == before
    
    
    @pytest.mark.timeout(280)
    def test_failed_live_migration_restores_data_checkout_and_runtime(
            private_comms, installed_home, install_checkout, tmp_path):
        comms, checkout = private_comms, install_checkout
        declare_test_bus(comms, channels=("comms",), threads=(
            comms.registry.new_thread(name="worker", tags=frozenset(), worktree=str(tmp_path)),))
        publish_initial(comms, "worker", "#all", "Retained before migration")
        saved = comms.root / "saved"
        saved.write_text("original")
        # This trigger is not a declared store or backup resource, so practice copying
        # leaves it behind. The same real worker succeeds in rehearsal and fails live.
        (comms.root / "fail-live").touch()
        current = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
        step = checkout / "tools/cutover/carry_fault.py"
        step.write_text('''from agent_comms.installer.carry import Carry, Carried
    class Fault(Carry):
        @classmethod
        def backup_files(cls, root):
            return (root / "saved",)
        @classmethod
        def carry(cls, root, *, apply):
            if apply:
                (root / "saved").write_text("changed by the worker")
                if (root / "fail-live").exists():
                    raise RuntimeError("intentional failure after writing the resource")
            return Carried(1, rewritten=("saved",))
    ''')
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", checkout, "add", step], check=True)
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", checkout, "-c", "user.name=Installer test",
                        "-c", "user.email=installer@example.invalid", "commit", "-qm",
                        "Migration that fails after writing on the live bus"], check=True)
        target = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", checkout, "checkout", "--detach", "-q", current], check=True)
        home = Path(installed_home["HOME"])
        pointer = home / ".local/share/agent-comms/current"
        outgoing = pointer.resolve()
        installed = subprocess.run(
            [Path(sys.executable).with_name("agent-comms"), "--root", comms.root, "install",
             "--checkout", checkout, "--to", target, "--project", checkout,
             "--spill-dir", tmp_path / "backups"],
            cwd=checkout, env={**installed_home, "PYTHONPATH": os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", "")},
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=270)
        assert installed.returncode != 0
        assert "Install rolled back:" in installed.stderr, installed.stderr
        assert "intentional failure after writing the resource" in installed.stderr
        assert saved.read_text() == "original"
        assert pointer.resolve() == outgoing
        assert (home / ".local/bin/agent-comms").resolve() == outgoing / "bin/agent-comms"
        assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", checkout, "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip() == current
        MaintenanceBarrier(RegistryStore.at(comms.root).path).read().phase.new_sends.require_open()
        assert comms.registry.require("worker").name == "worker"

    """Message journeys through a native session that more than one native test walks."""
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import asyncio
    from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
    
    from agent_comms.channel_targets import ChannelTarget, ThreadTarget
    from agent_comms.input_disposition import InputDispositions
    from toad.conversation_kind import ChannelConversation, DmConversation
    from toad.core import input_events
    from toad.navigation_target import DirectTarget, NavigationContext, channel_target
    from toad.widgets.comms_chat import CommsChatView
    from toad.notification_status import NotificationStatus
    
    from support.textual_steps import refresh_chat
    
    
    def rows_with(chat, predicate):
        return [fragment.message for fragment in chat.message_history.fragments_in_range
                if predicate(fragment.message)]
    
    
    def feedback_of(chat, sent) -> NotificationStatus:
        """The notification status drawn under the one message showing `sent`."""
        shown = [fragment.shown.status for fragment in chat.message_history.fragments_in_range
                 if fragment.message.reference == sent.reference]
        assert len(shown) == 1, (sent.reference, len(shown))
        return shown[0]
    
    
    async def direct_reply_feedback(native, owner_tab: str, *, hold: bool, target: str = "beta",
                                    body: str = "DIRECT_NATIVE_MESSAGE",
                                    reply_prefix: str | None = "NATIVE_RESPONSE_") -> None:
        """Send one direct message and follow it: responding while open, settled while hidden,
        answered exactly once on return, and once again after closing and reopening the tab.
    
        With `hold` the provider's reply waits until the tab is hidden.
        """
        ui, comms, provider = native.ui, native.comms, native.provider
        app, _pilot = ui.textual
        user = comms.messaging.user_identity(str(native.project)).name
        navigation = NavigationContext(app, owner_tab, native.project, user)
        await DirectTarget(target).open(navigation)
        screen = app.selected_session
        await screen.wait_content_ready()
        chat = screen.query_one(CommsChatView)
        assert chat.conversation == DmConversation(ThreadTarget(target))
        assert not rows_with(chat, lambda message: message.body == body)
        if hold:
            provider.hold_next_request()
        await chat.submit_input(input_events.UserInputSubmitted(body))
        if hold:
            await ui.until(provider.entered.is_set, seconds=30, why="the direct message at the provider")
        await ui.until(lambda: rows_with(chat, lambda message: message.body == body), seconds=20,
                       why="the sent message in the chat")
        sent_rows = rows_with(chat, lambda message: message.body == body)
        assert len(sent_rows) == 1
        sent = sent_rows[0]
        assert sent.sender == user and sent.target == target
        await ui.until(lambda: "Responding" in str(feedback_of(chat, sent).title), seconds=20,
                       why="'Responding' under the sent message")
        assert comms.registry.require(target).executing
    
        await ui.select_tab(owner_tab)
        assert app.selected_session is not screen
        provider.release()
        await ui.until(lambda: not comms.registry.require(target).executing, seconds=20,
                       why="the reply turn to finish while the chat is hidden")
        assert app.selected_session is not screen
    
        def replies():
            return rows_with(chat, lambda message: message.sender == target and message.seq > sent.seq
                             and (reply_prefix is None or message.body.startswith(reply_prefix)))
    
        await DirectTarget(target).open(navigation)
        assert app.selected_session is screen, "Returning replaced the open direct-message tab"
        await ui.until(replies, seconds=20, why="the reply in the chat")
        assert len(replies()) == 1
        reply = replies()[0]
        assert reply.target == user and reply.reference != sent.reference
        await ui.until(lambda: "Responded" in str(feedback_of(chat, sent).title), seconds=20,
                       why="'Responded' under the sent message")
        outcomes = await asyncio.to_thread(comms.views.message_notifications, (sent,))
        assert any(item.recipient == target and item.state == "Responded"
                   for item in outcomes[sent.seq, sent.message_id])
        if not hold:
            from agent_comms.input_origin import WireInputOrigin
    
            recipient = comms.registry.require(target)
            native_input = InputDispositions(comms.root / InputDispositions.filename).read().lookup(
                InputDispositions.bus_key(sent, recipient))
            assert native_input.has_started and native_input.matches_owner(recipient.incarnation)
            assert isinstance(native_input.origin, WireInputOrigin)
            assert native_input.origin.reference == sent.reference
    
        await ui.close_tab(screen.id)
        await DirectTarget(target).open(navigation)
        reopened = app.selected_session
        assert reopened is not screen and reopened.id != screen.id
        await reopened.wait_content_ready()
        fresh = reopened.query_one(CommsChatView)
        assert fresh.conversation == DmConversation(ThreadTarget(target))
        await ui.until(lambda: all(
            sum(fragment.message.reference == reference
                for fragment in fresh.message_history.fragments_in_range) == 1
            for reference in (sent.reference, reply.reference)), seconds=20,
            why="the message and its reply once each after reopening")
        await ui.until(lambda: "Responded" in str(feedback_of(fresh, sent).title), seconds=20,
                       why="'Responded' after reopening")
        await ui.select_tab(owner_tab)
    
    
    async def channel_message_feedback(native, owner_tab: str) -> None:
        """Send one channel message the thread declines: it shows as active while it decides,
        idle afterwards, and the message is marked checked with no response."""
        ui, comms, provider = native.ui, native.comms, native.provider
        app, _pilot = ui.textual
        user = comms.messaging.user_identity(str(native.project)).name
        await channel_target("#team").open(NavigationContext(app, owner_tab, native.project, user))
        await app.selected_session.wait_content_ready()
        chat = app.selected_session.query_one(CommsChatView)
        assert chat.conversation == ChannelConversation(ChannelTarget("#team"))
        provider.hold_next_request()
        await chat.submit_input(input_events.UserInputSubmitted("CHANNEL_NATIVE_TRIAGE"))
        await ui.until(provider.entered.is_set, seconds=30, why="the triage question at the provider")
        await ui.until(lambda: rows_with(chat, lambda message: message.body == "CHANNEL_NATIVE_TRIAGE"),
                       seconds=20, why="the sent message in the channel")
        sent_rows = rows_with(chat, lambda message: message.body == "CHANNEL_NATIVE_TRIAGE")
        assert len(sent_rows) == 1
        sent = sent_rows[0]
        await ui.until(lambda: comms.registry.require("beta").executing, seconds=20, why="the thread to be deciding")
        await refresh_chat(chat)
        await ui.step()
        provider.release()
        await ui.until(lambda: not comms.registry.require("beta").executing, seconds=20, why="the decision to finish")
        await refresh_chat(chat)
        await ui.until(lambda: "Checked" in feedback_of(chat, sent).title, seconds=10, why="'Checked' under the message")
        assert "no response" in feedback_of(chat, sent).title.lower(), feedback_of(chat, sent).title
    
    
    @asynccontextmanager
    async def goal_on_real_owner(workspace, objective: str, *, size=(110, 35), arrange=None):
        """A real owner (Core's ACP server in this process, no model) with an active goal, shown in Toad
        through an agent object bound to the owner's session.
    
        `arrange(comms, session, goal)` may change the goal on the owner before the view binds the agent.
        Yields (ui, agent, Core owner, session, goal as first set).
        """
        import os
    
        from agent_comms.goal_actions import SetGoalAction
    
        from support.native import owner_server, start_private_native_wire
    
        os.environ["AGENT_COMMS_AGENT_MODELS"] = "openrouter/fake"
        comms = start_private_native_wire(workspace.roots.wire)
        owner = owner_server(comms)
        try:
            session = (await owner.new_session(cwd=str(workspace.project))).session_id
            async with workspace.app(size=size) as ui:
                agent = ui.detached_agent()
                agent.coordination = comms.configuration.answer(session)
                goal = await agent.update_goal(SetGoalAction, objective)
                if arrange is not None:
                    arrange(comms, session, goal)
                conversation = ui.conversation
                conversation.bind_agent(agent)
                agent.ready = True
                await conversation.goal_observation.refresh()
                await ui.step()
                yield ui, agent, owner, session, goal
        finally:
            await owner.shutdown()

        def _stop_selection(self, name: str) -> tuple[Thread, int] | None:
            """Settle an owner that needs no signal, or capture the one that does."""
            with _store_lock(self._wire_lock_path):
                snapshot = self.registry.snapshot()
                thread = self.registry.require(name)
                thread.role.require_executable(
                    RelationViolationError("Only agent threads can be stopped.")
                )
                if not snapshot.status(thread.name).active and (
                    thread.process_identity.allows_inactive_stop()
                ):
                    return None
                if (
                    snapshot.status(thread.name).active
                    and thread.process_identity.runs_here()
                ):
                    if ThreadLaunch.called_by(
                        thread.name,
                        canonicalize=lambda caller: self.registry.require(caller).name,
                    ):
                        self._release_current_owner_unlocked(thread.name)
                    else:
                        self.registry.unregister(thread.name)
                    return None
                return thread, snapshot.claim_generation(thread.name)
    
        def stop(self, *names: str) -> None:
            owners = tuple(owner for name in dict.fromkeys(names)
                           if (owner := self._stop_selection(name)) is not None)
            # A process may already be dead. It still needs the exact release
            # acknowledgement before the execution owner can settle its attempted input.
            self._stop_processes(tuple(owner for owner in owners if owner[0].process_alive))
            # Stop is explicit abandonment of this exited local owner, not replay
            # permission. The existing recovery owner checks its exact release and
            # native-child absence before terminal settlement.
            for thread, generation in owners:
                self._finish_stopped_owner(thread, generation)
                RecoveryMonitorCapability.settle_stopped_owner(self.root, thread)

        def child_processes(self, marker: str) -> list:
            """This test's live child processes whose command line mentions `marker`."""
            import psutil
    
            found = []
            for process in psutil.Process().children(recursive=True):
                try:

            to resume (``resume``); ``session=False`` yields what it started with.

    class LaunchSelection(ABC):
        """The current selection owns its scoped installation and root requirement."""
    
        @abstractmethod
        def require(self) -> LaunchRoot: ...
    
        def install(self) -> None:
            LaunchRoot._current = self
    
        @contextmanager
        def selected(self) -> Iterator[Self]:
            previous = LaunchRoot._current
            self.install()
            try:
                yield self
            finally:
                previous.install()
    
    
    class UnstartedLaunch(LaunchSelection):
        """A process with no selected root; startup must run before use."""
    
        def require(self) -> LaunchRoot:
            raise RelationViolationError("Comms process did not select a root at startup.")
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class LaunchRoot(LaunchSelection):
        """A process's selected root travels in its arguments, never its environment."""
    
        path: Annotated[Path, PathText]
        argument: ClassVar[str] = "--comms-root"
        environment_name: ClassVar[str] = "AGENT_COMMS_ROOT"
        _current: ClassVar[LaunchSelection] = UnstartedLaunch()
    
        @classmethod
        def from_path(cls, path: str | Path) -> LaunchRoot:
            """Capture cwd/home now; keep symlinks for private-root validation."""
            return cls(Path(path).expanduser().absolute())
    
        @classmethod
        def unstarted(cls) -> UnstartedLaunch:
            return UnstartedLaunch()
    
        @classmethod
        def current(cls) -> LaunchRoot:
            return cls._current.require()
    
        def require(self) -> LaunchRoot:
            return self
    
        def arguments(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
            return self.argument, str(self.path)
    
        @classmethod
        def startup(cls, arguments: list[str], published: Callable[[], LaunchRoot]) -> None:
            if cls.argument in arguments:
                index = arguments.index(cls.argument)
                if index + 1 == len(arguments):
                    raise ValueError(f"{cls.argument} requires a root")
                record = FieldCodec.decode(cls, {"path": arguments[index + 1]})
                cls.from_path(record.path).install()
                del arguments[index : index + 2]
            else:
                published().install()
    
        @classmethod
        def environment(cls, source: Mapping[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
            """Construct child inheritance without an ambient root override."""
            return {name: value for name, value in source.items() if name != cls.environment_name}

    class AbsoluteRoutePathText(PathText):

                raise ValueError("active comms route requires absolute root and package identities")
            return path

        def from_text(cls, value: str) -> Path:
            return cls.require_absolute(super().from_text(value))

        root: Annotated[Path, AbsoluteRoutePathText]

        # The file format: the writer stamps it and the reader refuses any other before decoding.
        version: ClassVar[int] = 2
        # The CLI command that replaces a file this reader refuses; it registers under this name.
        repair_command: ClassVar[str] = "replace-route"
    
        @classmethod
        def published_launch(cls) -> LaunchRoot:
            match read_active_route():
                case ActiveRoute() as route:
                    if not route.root.is_dir():
                        raise ValueError("active comms route root is missing")
                    route.observe_root()
                    return LaunchRoot.from_path(route.root)
                case _:
                    raise RelationViolationError(
                        "No active Comms route is published; --comms-root or --root is required."
                    )
    
        def to_record(self) -> dict[str, object]:
            return {"version": self.version, **FieldCodec.encode(self)}
    
        @classmethod
        def from_record(cls, value: object, path: Path) -> ActiveRoute:
            match value:
                case {"version": int(found), **record} if found == cls.version:
                    pass
                case _:
                    stamped = value.get("version") if isinstance(value, dict) else None
                    raise MalformedRecord(
                        f"active comms route {path} is version {stamped!r}; "
                        f"this installation reads version {cls.version}. "
                        "Replace it with the bus it should select: "
                        f"agent-comms --root ROOT {cls.repair_command}")
            try:
                route = FieldCodec.decode(cls, record)
            except MalformedRecord as error:
                raise MalformedRecord(f"active comms route {path} is invalid: {error}") from error

        if isinstance(root, CommsRoute):

    from __future__ import annotations
    import asyncio
    import json
    import os
    from contextlib import ExitStack
    from contextvars import ContextVar
    from pathlib import Path
    from acp import Client, ClientSideConnection, schema
    from acp.connection import StreamDirection, StreamEvent
    from acp.exceptions import RequestError

    class AgentProcess(Client):
        def __init__(self, agent):
            self.agent = agent
            self.env = None
            self.cwd = None
            self.route_selection = None
            self.process = None
            self.connection: ClientSideConnection | None = None
            self.runner = None
            self.retirement = None
            self.cleanup = ExitStack()
            self.sessions = set()
            self.initialization = None
            self.command = None
            self.attachment_lock = asyncio.Lock()
            self._incoming: ContextVar[dict] = ContextVar('acp_incoming')
    
        @property
        def rpc(self) -> ClientSideConnection:
            if self.connection is None:
                raise ConnectionError('ACP process is not connected')
            return self.connection
    
        def accepts_attachment(self, agent, env, cwd, selection):
            response = self.initialization
            capabilities = response.agent_capabilities if response is not None else None
            lifecycle = capabilities.session_capabilities if capabilities is not None else None
            return (self.runner is not None and not self.runner.done()
                    and self.retirement is None and self.process is not None
                    and self.process.returncode is None
                    and lifecycle is not None and lifecycle.close is not None
                    and self.command == agent.command and self.env == env
                    and self.cwd == cwd and self.route_selection == selection
                    and agent.session_id is not None
                    and all(member.agent.session_id != agent.session_id for member in self.sessions))
    
        async def start(self, agent, processes=()):
            agent.session.reopen()
            agent.session.starting()
            await asyncio.to_thread(
                agent.presentation.log_path.parent.mkdir, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            from agent_comms.route_selection import RouteSelection
            env = os.environ.copy()
            cwd = str(agent.project_root_path.resolve())
            selection = RouteSelection.capture(agent.controller.transcripts.access.launch_root.path)
            with ExitStack() as acquisition:
                acquisition.enter_context(selection.route.hold_client_route())
                if not agent.session.accepts_updates:
                    return self
                for connection in dict.fromkeys((self, *processes)):
                    if connection.accepts_attachment(agent, env, cwd, selection):
                        agent.process = connection
                        connection.sessions.add(agent.session)
                        agent.controller.replace_terminal_session()
                        agent.session.start()
                        return connection
                connection = AgentProcess(agent) if self.sessions else self
                connection.agent = agent
                connection.env, connection.cwd, connection.route_selection = env, cwd, selection
                connection.command = agent.command
                connection.initialization = None
                connection.retirement = None
                agent.process = connection
                connection.sessions.add(agent.session)
                agent.controller.replace_terminal_session()
                connection.runner = asyncio.create_task(connection.run())
                connection.cleanup.enter_context(acquisition.pop_all())
                return connection
    
        async def prompt(self, agent, content, metadata, require):
            """The agent-comms-acp child writes the prompt under Core's maintenance gate."""
            require()
            return await self.rpc.prompt(agent.session_id, content, **metadata)
    
        def observe_stream(self, event: StreamEvent):
            """Keep the original frame with its SDK handler."""
            if event.direction is StreamDirection.INCOMING:
                # SDK creates the handler task immediately after this observer; its
                # context captures this frame, independently of later notifications.
                self._incoming.set(event.message)
                sender = 'agent'
            else:
                sender = 'client'
            line = f'[{sender}] {json.dumps(event.message)}'
            for session in tuple(self.sessions):
                session.agent.log(line)
    
        def recipient(self, session_id: str):
            members = tuple(member.agent for member in self.sessions if member.accepts_updates)
            for agent in members:
                if agent.session.accepts_session(session_id):
                    return agent
            if len(members) == 1 and not members[0].controller.session.bound:
                return members[0]
            raise RequestError.invalid_params({'details': 'ACP session is retired or unknown'})
    
        async def request_permission(self, session_id, tool_call, options, **kwargs):
            agent = self.recipient(session_id)
            return await agent.session.start_operation(
                agent.permissions.request_permission(session_id, options, tool_call, kwargs))
    
        async def session_update(self, session_id, update, **kwargs):
            agent = self.recipient(session_id)
            notification = schema.SessionNotification.model_construct(
                session_id=session_id, update=update, field_meta=kwargs or None)
            raw = self._incoming.get()['params']['update']
            await agent.session.start_operation(agent.updates.receive(notification, raw))

    """Shell syntax is decoded at the command boundary, not at retirement."""
    from abc import abstractmethod
    import os
    from agent_comms.declared_family import DeclaredFamily
    
    
    class ShellCommand(DeclaredFamily, affix="ShellCommand"):
        @classmethod
        def current(cls):
            return cls.member_named(os.name)()
    
        @abstractmethod
        def argv(self, command: str, *, accepts_comms_root: bool = False) -> tuple[str, ...]: ...
    
    
    class PosixShellCommand(ShellCommand):
        def argv(self, command, *, accepts_comms_root=False):
            if accepts_comms_root:
                # Core appends the typed launch arguments after this shell's $0.
                # Without $@ they become shell positionals, not ACP child arguments.
                return ("/bin/sh", "-c", f'{command} "$@"', "toad-acp")
            return ("/bin/sh", "-c", command)
    
    
    class NtShellCommand(ShellCommand):
        def argv(self, command, *, accepts_comms_root=False):
            return (os.environ.get("COMSPEC", "cmd.exe"), "/c", command)
    
        async def retire(self):
            for session in tuple(self.sessions):
                session.close()
                for task in tuple(session.responses):
                    task.cancel()
            if self.retirement is None:
                self.retirement = asyncio.create_task(self._retire())
            await join_retirement(self.retirement)
    
        async def _retire(self):
            try:
                if self.connection is not None:
                    await self.connection.close()
                    self.connection = None
                await asyncio.gather(*(session.retire() for session in tuple(self.sessions)),
                                     return_exceptions=True)
            finally:
                if self.process is not None:
                    await self.process.stop()
                self.process = None
                self.sessions.clear()
                self.cleanup.close()
    
        async def detach(self, session):
            async with self.attachment_lock:
                if session not in self.sessions:
                    return
                try:
                    if (self.retirement is None and len(self.sessions) > 1
                            and session.disposition.held_by_agent):
                        task = asyncio.create_task(self.rpc.close_session(session.agent.session_id))
                        session.responses.add(task)
                        task.add_done_callback(session.responses.discard)
                        await task
                except BaseException:
                    if self.runner is not None:
                        self.runner.cancel()
                    raise
                finally:
                    self.sessions.discard(session)
                if not self.sessions and self.retirement is None and self.runner is not None:
                    self.runner.cancel()
    
        async def stop(self, agent):
            agent.session.close()
            await agent.session.retire()
            if not self.sessions:
                if self.runner is not None and self.runner is not asyncio.current_task():
                    self.runner.cancel()
                    await asyncio.gather(self.runner, return_exceptions=True)
                await self.retire()
                self.runner = None
    
        async def run(self):
            try:
                await self.communicate()
            finally:
                await self.retire()
    
        async def communicate(self) -> None:
            agent = self.agent
            env = (self.env or os.environ).copy()
            env['TOAD_CWD'] = str(Path('./').absolute())
            if (command := self.command) is None:
                agent.session.startup_failed('No run command for this OS')
                return
            try:
                accepts_root = agent.definition.accepts_comms_root
                launch = LaunchRoot.from_path(self.route_selection.root)
                process = self.process = await AttachedChild.start(
                    (*ShellCommand.current().argv(command, accepts_comms_root=accepts_root),
                     *(launch.arguments() if accepts_root else ())),
                    env=LaunchRoot.environment(env), cwd=self.cwd,
                    stdio=StreamingChildStdio(limit=10 * 1024 * 1024),
                )
            except (FileNotFoundError, PermissionError) as error:
                agent.session.startup_failed(str(error))
                return
            assert process.stdout is not None
            assert process.stdin is not None
            self.connection = ClientSideConnection(
                self, process.stdin, process.stdout, observers=[self.observe_stream])
            agent.session.start()
            outcome = await process.wait()
            fail_details = await process.stderr_tail()

    class HoldTranscriptsProbe(RuntimeProbe[None]):
        path: Annotated[Path, PathText]
        ready_fd: int
    
        def run(self) -> None:
            from contextlib import closing
            from agent_comms.coordination_database import CoordinationStore
            with closing(CoordinationStore.writer(self.path, isolation_level=None)) as writer:
                writer.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                with open(self.ready_fd, "wb") as held:
                    held.write(b"held")
                sys.stdin.read()
                writer.execute("ROLLBACK")
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class InstalledPackagesProbe(RuntimeProbe[dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]):
        core: str
    
        def run(self) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
            from importlib.metadata import distributions
            from packaging.utils import canonicalize_name
            import agent_comms
            from agent_comms.package_stamp import STAMP
            if not Path(agent_comms.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve()):
                raise ValueError("Core is editable, not a built runtime package")
            if STAMP.commit() != self.core:
                raise ValueError("The wheel stamp does not name the selected source")
            return {canonicalize_name(dist.metadata["Name"]): {
                "version": dist.version,
                "source": json.loads(source) if (source := dist.read_text("direct_url.json")) else None,
            } for dist in distributions()}
    
    
    class DistributionVersionsProbe(RuntimeProbe[dict[str, str]]):
        def run(self) -> dict[str, str]:
            from importlib.metadata import distributions
            from packaging.utils import canonicalize_name
            return {canonicalize_name(dist.metadata["Name"]): dist.version for dist in distributions()}
    
    
    def main() -> None:
        encoded, result = sys.argv[1:]
        probe = FieldCodec.decode(RuntimeProbe, FieldCodec.parse(encoded))
        Path(result).write_text(probe.encode_answer(probe.run()))

    import pytest

    from support.routes import private_root, select_root_by_default_route
    
    
    @pytest.fixture
    def published(tmp_path, monkeypatch, native_package):
        """A legacy root, and a private root published as the default route."""
        tmp_path.chmod(0o700)
        for name in ("CONFIG", "DATA", "STATE"):
            monkeypatch.setenv(f"XDG_{name}_HOME", str(tmp_path / name.lower()))
        home = select_root_by_default_route(monkeypatch, tmp_path)
        legacy = home / ".agent-comms"
        legacy.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        private, private_id = private_root(tmp_path / "wire", tmp_path, "PRIVATE-ONLY")
        route = ActiveRoute(private, private_id, native_package)
        assert current_root() == legacy
        with patch.object(private_nk_entrypoint, "_trusted_package", lambda _: None):
            publish_active_route(route)
        assert current_root() == private
        return SimpleNamespace(legacy=legacy, private=private, private_id=private_id, route=route, cwd=tmp_path)
    
    
    def test_a_write_selected_before_the_flip_is_refused_after_it(published):
        invoked = []
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            run_selected_write(published.legacy, invoked.append, None, implicit=True)
        assert not invoked

    class OrphanDefect(pytest.PytestWarning):
        """An open defect stays recorded after its test is deleted; it needs a new reproducer."""
    
    
    def open_defects() -> dict[str, tuple[str, bool]]:
        """Test id -> (why it is expected to fail, whether it only fails some of the time)."""
        import tomllib
    
        return {test: (f"open defect {name} ({entry['owner']}): {entry['defect']}", entry.get("intermittent", False))
                for name, entry in tomllib.loads(OPEN_DEFECTS.read_text()).items() for test in entry["tests"]}

                         help="Wall seconds one app test may take, once (no retries)")

    class OwnProcessTest(pytest.Item):
        """Runs one collected test in a fresh interpreter that owns disposable roots.
    
        The app keeps process-wide state (render workers, the comms route, settings
        paths, frozen heap), so two app tests never share an interpreter.
        """
    
        def runtest(self):
            from agent_comms.child_process import BoundedRun
            from support.processes import stop_test_children
    
            roots = Roots.create()
            result = roots.attempt / "result.jsonl"
            env = roots.environment(dict(os.environ)) | {RESULT: str(result)}
            command = (sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", self.nodeid, "-p", "no:cacheprovider",
                       "-q", "--no-header", "--tb=short", "--color=no")
    
            async def run():
                try:
                    return await BoundedRun.run(command, timeout=self.config.getoption("--test-timeout"),
                                                cwd=self.config.rootpath, env=env)
                finally:
                    # Closing the app leaves owners and helpers running; stop the ones this test started.
                    await stop_test_children(str(roots.attempt))
    
            child = asyncio.run(run())
            reports = [json.loads(line) for line in result.read_text().splitlines()] if result.exists() else []
            output = child.stdout.decode(errors="replace")[-12000:] + child.stderr.decode(errors="replace")[-4000:]
            failed = not child.outcome.successful or not reports
            if (defect := open_defects().get(self.nodeid)) is not None:
                reason, intermittent = defect
                shutil.rmtree(roots.attempt, ignore_errors=True)
                if failed:
                    pytest.xfail(reason)
                if intermittent:
                    return
                pytest.fail(f"{self.nodeid} passes; remove it from tests/open_defects.toml", pytrace=False)
            if failed:
                pytest.fail(f"{child.outcome!r}\n{output}\nRoots kept: {roots.attempt}", pytrace=False)
            shutil.rmtree(roots.attempt)
            for report in reports:
                if report["outcome"] == "skipped":
                    pytest.skip(report["reason"])

    def selected_triage_reply(request: dict, decision=None) -> dict | None:
        """The answer to Core's "should this thread respond" question, when `request` is one."""
        from agent_comms.field_codec import FieldCodec
        from agent_comms.selected_triage import IgnoreSelectedTriage, SelectedTriage
        from agent_comms.turn_context import InstructionFile
    
        texts = last_user_texts(request)
        output = InstructionFile.read("selected-triage-output.md").render(SelectedTriage.output_values()).strip()
        if not any(text.rstrip().endswith(output) for text in texts):
            return None
        return {"role": "assistant", "content": json.dumps(FieldCodec.encode(
            IgnoreSelectedTriage() if decision is None else decision))}
    
    
    def wire_reply(request: dict, answer: str) -> dict | None:
        """The answer to a wire message, in the form Core asks for: its example records with `answer` as text."""
        from agent_comms.turn_context import InstructionFile
    
        placeholder = InstructionFile.read("selected-response-example.md").content
        marker = "Declared Message examples: "
        for text in last_user_texts(request):
            if marker in text:
                examples, _end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(text[text.index(marker) + len(marker):])
                records = json.loads(json.dumps(examples).replace(json.dumps(placeholder), json.dumps(answer)))
                return {"role": "assistant", "content": json.dumps(records)}
        return None
    
    
    def numbered_reply(request: dict, number: int) -> tuple[dict, str]:
        """Declines triage questions and answers anything else ``NATIVE_RESPONSE_<n>``."""
        answer = f"NATIVE_RESPONSE_{number}"
        return (selected_triage_reply(request) or wire_reply(request, answer)
                or {"role": "assistant", "content": answer}), "stop"

    @dataclass
    class ControlledProvider:
        """A loopback chat-completions endpoint: records each request and streams the chosen reply."""
    
        reply: Callable[[dict, int], tuple[dict, str]] = numbered_reply
        usage: Callable[[dict, int], dict] = small_usage
        request_budget: int = 12
        chunk_characters: int | None = None
        after_chunk: Callable[[int, int], None] | None = None
        expected_disconnects: frozenset[int] = frozenset()
        requests: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
        failures: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
        entered: threading.Event = field(default_factory=threading.Event)
        released: threading.Event = field(default_factory=threading.Event)
        holding: threading.Event = field(default_factory=threading.Event)
    
        def hold_next_request(self) -> None:
            """The next request waits, after setting `entered`, until `release()`."""
            self.entered.clear()
            self.released.clear()
            self.holding.set()
    
        def release(self) -> None:
            self.released.set()
    
        def answer(self, handler: BaseHTTPRequestHandler) -> None:
            number = None
            try:
                request = json.loads(handler.rfile.read(int(handler.headers["Content-Length"])))
                self.requests.append(request)
                number = len(self.requests)
                assert request["model"] == "fixture"
                assert handler.headers["Authorization"] == f"Bearer {KEY}"
                assert number <= self.request_budget, "The native agent keeps asking the model"
                if self.holding.is_set():
                    self.holding.clear()
                    self.entered.set()
                    assert self.released.wait(20), "The test never released the held model reply"
                reply, finish_reason = self.reply(request, number)
                chunk = {"id": "offline", "object": "chat.completion.chunk", "created": 1, "model": "fixture",
                         "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": reply, "finish_reason": None}]}
                final = {**chunk, "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": {}, "finish_reason": finish_reason}],
                         "usage": self.usage(request, number)}
                chunks = [chunk]
                if self.chunk_characters is not None:
                    text = reply.get("content", "")
                    chunks = [{**chunk, "choices": [{"index": 0, "delta": {
                        **({"role": "assistant"} if offset == 0 else {}),
                        "content": text[offset:offset + self.chunk_characters],
                    }, "finish_reason": None}]} for offset in range(0, len(text), self.chunk_characters)]
                rows = [("data: " + json.dumps(row) + "\n\n").encode() for row in (*chunks, final)]
                handler.send_response(200)
                handler.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
                if self.after_chunk is None:
                    body = b"".join(rows) + b"data: [DONE]\n\n"
                    handler.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
                    handler.end_headers()
                    handler.wfile.write(body)
                    return
                handler.end_headers()
                for index, row in enumerate(rows):
                    handler.wfile.write(row)
                    handler.wfile.flush()
                    self.after_chunk(number, index)
                handler.wfile.write(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
            except BrokenPipeError:
                if number not in self.expected_disconnects:
                    self.failures.append(f"request {number}: the native agent closed the reply early")
            except Exception as error:
                self.failures.append(repr(error))
                try:
                    handler.send_error(400, "Controlled provider failed")
                except OSError:
                    pass
    
        @contextmanager
        def serving(self):
            """Serve on a free loopback port; yields the base URL."""
            provider = self
    
            class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
                def do_POST(self):
                    provider.answer(self)
    
                def log_message(self, *_args):
                    pass
    
            server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
            threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
            try:
                yield f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/v1"
            finally:
                self.release()
                server.shutdown()
                server.server_close()

    from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
    import asyncio
    from weakref import ref
    
    from agent_comms.goal_presentation import GoalSnapshot

    class SessionObservation(ABC):
        errors = (OSError, ValueError)
    
        def __init__(self, view):
            self._view = ref(view)
            self.revision = 0
            self.task = None
    
        @property
        def view(self):
            return self._view() if self._view is not None else None
    
        @property
        def active(self):
            return self.task is not None and not self.task.done()
    
        def invalidate(self):
            view = self.view
            if view is None or not view.is_attached:
                return
            view.agent_binding.invalidate_observation(self)
    
        def schedule(self, agent):
            self.agent = agent
            self.revision += 1
            if not self.active:
                self.task = asyncio.create_task(self._run())
    
        async def refresh(self):
            self.invalidate()
            task = self.task
            if task is not None:
                try:
                    await asyncio.shield(task)
                except asyncio.CancelledError:
                    # Source retirement owns cancellation of its read. A callback
                    # awaiting that read must not cancel the retained UI pump.
                    if self.view is None and task.cancelled() and not asyncio.current_task().cancelling():
                        return
                    raise
    
        async def close(self):
            self._view = None
            self.revision += 1
            if self.active:
                self.task.cancel()
                await asyncio.gather(self.task, return_exceptions=True)
            self.task = None
    
        @staticmethod
        async def close_all(*observations: "SessionObservation") -> None:
            """Join every independent observation before reporting close failures."""
            results = await asyncio.gather(
                *(observation.close() for observation in observations), return_exceptions=True,
            )
            errors = [result for result in results if isinstance(result, BaseException)]
            if errors:
                raise BaseExceptionGroup("Session observations failed to close", errors)
    
        def receive(self, agent, result):
            """An owner fact supersedes an older in-flight read of that source."""
            view = self.view
            if view is None or not view.is_attached or not view.agent_binding.matches_agent(agent):
                return
            self.revision += 1
            self.publish(view, result)
    
        async def _run(self):
            while (view := self.view) is not None and view.is_attached:
                revision = self.revision
                agent = self.agent
                try:
                    result = await self.read(agent)
                except self.errors as error:
                    if self.view is not view or not view.is_attached:
                        return
                    if revision != self.revision or not view.agent_binding.matches_agent(agent):
                        continue
                    self.failed(view, error)
                    return
                if self.view is not view or not view.is_attached:
                    return
                if revision != self.revision or not view.agent_binding.matches_agent(agent):
                    continue
                self.publish(view, result)
                return
    
        @abstractmethod
        async def read(self, agent): ...
    
        @abstractmethod
        def publish(self, view, result): ...
    
        @abstractmethod
        def failed(self, view, error): ...

        def publish(self, view, result: GoalSnapshot):
            view.goal_display = result.goal
            view.goal_execution = result.execution
    
        def failed(self, view, error):
            view.goal_display = GoalUnavailable(view.goal_display.snapshot)
    
    
    class InputDeliveryObservation(SessionObservation):
        errors = (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError, KeyError)
    
        async def read(self, agent) -> InputDelivery:
            return await agent.controller.input_delivery()
    
        def publish(self, view, result: InputDelivery):
            view.input_delivery = result
    
        def failed(self, view, error):
            view.input_delivery = view.input_delivery.failed(error)
    
        def require_owner(self, agent):
            if self.view is None or not self.view.is_attached or not self.view.agent_binding.matches_agent(agent):
                raise ValueError("The connected owner changed; inspect delivery again.")
    
        def current_owner(self):
            self.require_owner(self.agent)
            return self.agent
    
        async def history(self):
            agent = self.current_owner()
            while True:
                revision = self.revision
                result = await agent.controller.input_delivery(include_history=True)
                self.require_owner(agent)
                if revision != self.revision:
                    continue
                await self.refresh()
                self.require_owner(agent)
                if self.view.input_delivery.error:
                    raise ValueError(self.view.input_delivery.error)
                if revision + 1 != self.revision or result.history_changed(self.view.input_delivery):
                    continue
                return result.historical_inputs
    
        async def dismiss_history(self):
            agent = self.current_owner()
            await agent.controller.dismiss_historical_inputs()
            self.require_owner(agent)
            await self.refresh()
            self.require_owner(agent)
            if self.view.input_delivery.error:
                raise ValueError(self.view.input_delivery.error)
    class InstructionFile:
        """One immutable read used for both rendering and file provenance."""
    
        content: str
        source: FileProvenance
    
        @classmethod
        def read(cls, name: str) -> InstructionFile:
            path = Path(__file__).with_name("instructions") / name
            raw = path.read_bytes()
            return cls(raw.decode(), FileProvenance(str(path), hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()))

    class ContextSources:
        """Find native journal positions from the records contributing to this context."""
    
        provenance: tuple[Provenance, ...]
    
        def native_identity(self) -> NativeSessionIdentity:
            originals = {identity for source in self.provenance for identity in source.native_identities()}
            if len(originals) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Original segment has no unambiguous native source identity")
            (identity,) = originals
            return identity

    """One bounded decoded decision owns its claim settlement and continuation."""
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import json
    from abc import abstractmethod
    from dataclasses import dataclass
    from functools import partial
    from typing import ClassVar, Literal
    
    from .assignment_states import FailedAssignment, IgnoredAssignment, TriagePendingAssignment
    from .coordination_tables.assignments import WakeAssignment
    from .coordinator import Coordination
    from .declared_family import DeclaredFamily
    from .field_codec import (
        FieldCodec,
        JsonShapeFamily,
        JsonShapeMember,
        MalformedRecord,
        TextRepresentation,
    )
    from .typed_table import TextStorage
    
    
    class InvalidTriageDecision(ValueError):
        """A model result violates its contract; participant identity is unchanged."""
    
    
    class SelectedTriage(DeclaredFamily, affix="SelectedTriage"):
        family_discriminator = "decision"
    
        @classmethod
        def output_values(cls) -> dict[str, str]:
            names = [member.declared_name for member in cls.members_with(cls)]
            return dict(discriminator=cls.family_discriminator, names=json.dumps(names))
    
        @classmethod
        def parse(cls, text: str) -> SelectedTriage:
            if not 0 < len(text.encode("utf-8")) <= 256:
                raise InvalidTriageDecision("triage response is not bounded")
            try:
                return FieldCodec.decode(cls, FieldCodec.parse(text))
            except MalformedRecord as error:
                raise InvalidTriageDecision("triage response is not an unambiguous decision") from error
    
        @classmethod
        def recognizes(cls, text: str) -> bool:
            """Whether this text decodes as a bounded verdict from this family."""
            try:
                cls.parse(text)
            except InvalidTriageDecision:
                return False
            return True
    
        @classmethod
        @abstractmethod
        def proves_source(cls, evidence) -> bool: ...
    
        @abstractmethod
        def settle(self, store, db, current: WakeAssignment) -> None: ...
    
        @abstractmethod
        async def continue_turn(self, participant, session, input_id, execution, settled): ...
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class IgnoreSelectedTriage(SelectedTriage, declared_name="IGNORE"):
        @classmethod
        def proves_source(cls, evidence) -> bool:
            return True
    
        def settle(self, store, db, current):
            # Both declared edges stay in the native proof's one transaction. Never
            # publish a retryable TRIAGE_PENDING state after the input has been sent.
            now = store.session.now(current.updated_at_ms)
            WakeAssignment.update(
                db,
                where="assignment_id=?",
                parameters=(current.assignment_id,),
                lifecycle=TriagePendingAssignment(),
                revision=current.revision + 1,
                updated_at_ms=now,
            )
            WakeAssignment.update(
                db,
                where="assignment_id=?",
                parameters=(current.assignment_id,),
                lifecycle=IgnoredAssignment(),
                revision=current.revision + 2,
                updated_at_ms=store.session.now(now),
            )
    
        async def continue_turn(self, participant, session, input_id, execution, settled):
            from .selected_result import CoordinatedTurn
    
            await Coordination.run_worker(participant.consume_reply_wait)
            return await CoordinatedTurn.capture(participant, input_id, IgnoredAssignment)
    
    
    @dataclass(frozen=True)
    class FullSelectedTriage(SelectedTriage, declared_name="FULL"):
        @classmethod
        def proves_source(cls, evidence) -> bool:
            return any(proof.execution.proves_full_source(proof) for proof in evidence)
    
        def settle(self, store, db, current):
            # Deferred until the execution owner atomically engages this exact claim.
            pass
    
        async def continue_turn(self, participant, session, input_id, execution, settled):
            from .coordination_tables.executions import ExecutionOrigin
    
            await participant.require_current()
            created = participant.store.executions.create_after_triage(
                participant.batch.execution_id, ExecutionOrigin.WIRE,
                participant.lookup, participant.owner.thread.name,
                execution.max_attempts,
                sources=participant.batch.sources, settled=settled,
            ).value
            return await execution.full(participant, session, created)
    
    
    class SelectedTriageOutcome(DeclaredFamily, affix="TriageOutcome"):
        """One decoded model result owns settlement and continued inbox behavior."""
